question: How does the Goddess relate to the knowledge and the enemy of the ten-headed one?
premises: The Goddess gives knowledge to the ten-headed one.
The Goddess takes form as the enemy of the ten-headed one.
inference: The Goddess both instructs the ten-headed one and manifests as his opponent.
uncertainties: The ten-headed one and his enemy are not explicitly named in this verse.
plain_english: She is the giver of knowledge to the ten-headed one and embodied as the enemy of the ten-headed one.
